CREATE TABLE `booking` (
  `booking_id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `booking_code` varchar(30) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `screening_id` int NOT NULL,
  `customer_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `employee_id` int NOT NULL,
  `booked_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  `booking_status` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CONFIRMED',
  PRIMARY KEY (`booking_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_booking_code` (`booking_code`),
  KEY `idx_booking_screening` (`screening_id`,`booking_status`),
  KEY `idx_booking_customer` (`customer_id`),
  KEY `idx_booking_employee` (`employee_id`),
  KEY `idx_booking_booked_at` (`booked_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_booking_customer` FOREIGN KEY (`customer_id`) REFERENCES `customer` (`customer_id`) ON DELETE SET NULL ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_booking_employee` FOREIGN KEY (`employee_id`) REFERENCES `employee` (`employee_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_booking_screening` FOREIGN KEY (`screening_id`) REFERENCES `screening` (`screening_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_booking_status` CHECK ((`booking_status` in (_utf8mb4'CONFIRMED',_utf8mb4'PENDING',_utf8mb4'CANCELLED')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=1000808 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `cinema_branch` (
  `branch_id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `branch_code` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `branch_name` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `address` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `city` varchar(80) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `phone` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  PRIMARY KEY (`branch_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_branch_code` (`branch_code`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_branch_name` (`branch_name`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_branch_phone` (`phone`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_branch_active` CHECK ((`active` in (0,1)))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=1000208 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `customer` (
  `customer_id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `full_name` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `phone` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `email` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `birth_date` date DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`customer_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_customer_phone` (`phone`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_customer_email` (`email`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=1000081 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `employee` (
  `employee_id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `branch_id` int NOT NULL,
  `employee_code` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `full_name` varchar(120) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `phone` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `role` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CASHIER',
  `hired_date` date NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`employee_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_employee_code` (`employee_code`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_employee_phone` (`phone`),
  KEY `idx_employee_branch` (`branch_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_employee_branch` FOREIGN KEY (`branch_id`) REFERENCES `cinema_branch` (`branch_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_employee_role` CHECK ((`role` in (_utf8mb4'CASHIER',_utf8mb4'MANAGER',_utf8mb4'ACCOUNTANT')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=1000208 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `genre` (
  `genre_id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `genre_name` varchar(80) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `description` varchar(255) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`genre_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_genre_name` (`genre_name`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=9 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `movie` (
  `movie_id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `movie_code` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `title` varchar(180) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `duration_minutes` int NOT NULL,
  `release_date` date NOT NULL,
  `age_rating` varchar(10) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'P',
  `country` varchar(80) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `description` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci,
  PRIMARY KEY (`movie_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_movie_code` (`movie_code`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_movie_dur` CHECK (((`duration_minutes` >= 1) and (`duration_minutes` <= 400))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_movie_rating` CHECK ((`age_rating` in (_utf8mb4'P',_utf8mb4'K',_utf8mb4'T13',_utf8mb4'T16',_utf8mb4'T18')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=1000121 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `movie_genre` (
  `movie_id` int NOT NULL,
  `genre_id` int NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`movie_id`,`genre_id`),
  KEY `idx_mg_genre` (`genre_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_mg_genre` FOREIGN KEY (`genre_id`) REFERENCES `genre` (`genre_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_mg_movie` FOREIGN KEY (`movie_id`) REFERENCES `movie` (`movie_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `payment` (
  `payment_id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `booking_id` int NOT NULL,
  `amount` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,
  `payment_method` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'CASH',
  `payment_status` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'SUCCESS',
  `paid_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  `transaction_ref` varchar(60) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `active_success_booking` int GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when (`payment_status` = _utf8mb4'SUCCESS') then `booking_id` else NULL end)) STORED,
  PRIMARY KEY (`payment_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_payment_one_success` (`active_success_booking`),
  KEY `idx_payment_status_paid_at` (`payment_status`,`paid_at`),
  KEY `idx_payment_booking` (`booking_id`,`payment_status`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_payment_booking` FOREIGN KEY (`booking_id`) REFERENCES `booking` (`booking_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE RESTRICT,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_payment_amount` CHECK ((`amount` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_payment_method` CHECK ((`payment_method` in (_utf8mb4'CASH',_utf8mb4'CARD',_utf8mb4'TRANSFER',_utf8mb4'EWALLET'))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_payment_status` CHECK ((`payment_status` in (_utf8mb4'PENDING',_utf8mb4'SUCCESS',_utf8mb4'FAILED',_utf8mb4'REFUNDED')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=1000812 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `screening` (
  `screening_id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `movie_id` int NOT NULL,
  `room_id` int NOT NULL,
  `start_time` datetime NOT NULL,
  `end_time` datetime NOT NULL,
  `base_price` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,
  `status` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'OPEN',
  PRIMARY KEY (`screening_id`),
  KEY `idx_screening_room_time` (`room_id`,`start_time`,`end_time`),
  KEY `idx_screening_movie_time` (`movie_id`,`start_time`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_screening_movie` FOREIGN KEY (`movie_id`) REFERENCES `movie` (`movie_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_screening_room` FOREIGN KEY (`room_id`) REFERENCES `screening_room` (`room_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_screening_price` CHECK ((`base_price` > 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_screening_stat` CHECK ((`status` in (_utf8mb4'OPEN',_utf8mb4'CANCELLED'))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_screening_time` CHECK ((`end_time` > `start_time`))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=1000405 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `screening_room` (
  `room_id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `branch_id` int NOT NULL,
  `room_name` varchar(60) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `room_type` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT '2D',
  `active` tinyint(1) NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  PRIMARY KEY (`room_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_room_branch_name` (`branch_id`,`room_name`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_room_branch` FOREIGN KEY (`branch_id`) REFERENCES `cinema_branch` (`branch_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_room_active` CHECK ((`active` in (0,1))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_room_type` CHECK ((`room_type` in (_utf8mb4'2D',_utf8mb4'3D',_utf8mb4'IMAX')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=1000256 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `screening_seat_lock` (
  `screening_id` int NOT NULL,
  `seat_id` int NOT NULL,
  `ticket_id` int NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`screening_id`,`seat_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_ssl_ticket` (`ticket_id`),
  KEY `idx_ssl_seat` (`seat_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_ssl_screening` FOREIGN KEY (`screening_id`) REFERENCES `screening` (`screening_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_ssl_seat` FOREIGN KEY (`seat_id`) REFERENCES `seat` (`seat_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_ssl_ticket` FOREIGN KEY (`ticket_id`) REFERENCES `ticket` (`ticket_id`) ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `seat` (
  `seat_id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `room_id` int NOT NULL,
  `seat_row` char(1) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `seat_number` int NOT NULL,
  `seat_type_code` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'STD',
  PRIMARY KEY (`seat_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_seat_position` (`room_id`,`seat_row`,`seat_number`),
  KEY `idx_seat_type` (`seat_type_code`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_seat_room` FOREIGN KEY (`room_id`) REFERENCES `screening_room` (`room_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_seat_type` FOREIGN KEY (`seat_type_code`) REFERENCES `seat_type` (`seat_type_code`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_seat_number` CHECK (((`seat_number` >= 1) and (`seat_number` <= 50))),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_seat_row` CHECK (((`seat_row` >= _utf8mb4'A') and (`seat_row` <= _utf8mb4'Z')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=1011191 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `seat_type` (
  `seat_type_code` varchar(16) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `type_name` varchar(60) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `surcharge` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL DEFAULT '0.00',
  PRIMARY KEY (`seat_type_code`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_seat_type_name` (`type_name`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_seat_surcharge` CHECK ((`surcharge` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_seat_type_code` CHECK ((`seat_type_code` in (_utf8mb4'STD',_utf8mb4'VIP',_utf8mb4'COUPLE')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci

CREATE TABLE `ticket` (
  `ticket_id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `booking_id` int NOT NULL,
  `seat_id` int NOT NULL,
  `unit_price` decimal(12,2) NOT NULL,
  `ticket_status` varchar(20) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'VALID',
  `cancelled_at` datetime DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`ticket_id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uq_ticket_booking_seat` (`booking_id`,`seat_id`),
  KEY `idx_ticket_booking_status` (`booking_id`,`ticket_status`),
  KEY `idx_ticket_seat` (`seat_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `fk_ticket_booking` FOREIGN KEY (`booking_id`) REFERENCES `booking` (`booking_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `fk_ticket_seat` FOREIGN KEY (`seat_id`) REFERENCES `seat` (`seat_id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT ON UPDATE CASCADE,
  CONSTRAINT `chk_ticket_price` CHECK ((`unit_price` >= 0)),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_ticket_status` CHECK ((`ticket_status` in (_utf8mb4'VALID',_utf8mb4'CANCELLED')))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=1001413 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
